## Part 3
(10 points)

Show that every finite language is regular.
There are different ways one might do this.
One way, for example, is to show that given a finite language
$$L = \{s_{1}, ..., s_{n}\}$$
you can construct a finite-state automaton which accepts exactly the strings in $L$.

Note that a simple way to show this uses the definition of regular languages, but constructing the finite-state automaton might be more fun!
